question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM for the underlined word in the given sentence.

Because the politician made a __candid __speech, he earned the respect of the voters.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"candid"** means being** open, honest, and straightforward in speech or expression.** (ईमानदार)

 
 
• **Example:** She gave a candid interview about her experiences in the industry.
 
 
 
• **"Deceitful"** refers to someone who is dishonest and aims to deceive or mislead others. (धोखेबाज)
 
 
• **Example:** He was known for his** deceitful **tactics in business negotiations.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'candid'** is **'deceitful'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Reckless** (लापरवाह): Showing a lack of care about the consequences of an action.

 
 
• **Example:** His** reckless** driving almost caused an accident.
 
 
 
• **Reticent** (अल्पभाषी): Not revealing one's thoughts or feelings readily.
 
 
• **Example:** She was **reticent** about her plans for the future.
 
 
 
• **Prudent** (सावधान): Acting with or showing care and thought for the future.
 
 
• **Example:** It is **prudent** to save money for unexpected expense.
